annotations.title: Finwire Nowcast: inflation and RPP forecasts

description: Finwire Nowcast (finwire id: finwire_nowcast), the finwire.pl statistical model of the next official readings: CPI inflation y/y and core inflation y/y (point and 80% interval) and probabilities of a cut, no change or hike at the next RPP (Monetary Policy Council) meeting. Recomputed daily, frozen 3 working days before publication, then settled against the actual reading; with backtest accuracy vs naive benchmarks. A model estimate, not a consensus and not investment advice.

history.description: Recent settled or backtest points per indicator, default 6.

indicator.description: One indicator; omit for all three.
